scope: Late 2026-06-24 R124plus German source-audit wave after the latest published Noether record 20828102. Contains small source-visible cumulative TeX/PDF repairs for Papers 09, 10, 19, 20, and 30, plus no-patch best-available source-audit evidence for neighboring Paper 09, Paper 10, and Paper 12 ranges. Latest addition is a clean single-root package for Paper 30 pp.41-44 restoring the source-visible congruence relation before `0(a,b)` on p41 and recording p42-p44 as no-patch checks.
publish_decision: Do not upload each micro-drop as a separate public file. If publishing this wave, prefer one grouped Noether update or one clearly labelled source-audit supplement. Describe all items as targeted German source-visible repairs or no-patch audits against best-available local witnesses, not as a complete Noether reader edition or critical edition.
